intro.what: Past Simple (o'tgan oddiy zamon) o'tmishda tugagan ish-harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi. Noto'g'ri fe'llar (irregular verbs) o'tgan zamon darak gaplarida o'ziga xos shaklga ega bo'ladi va ularga -ed qo'shimchasi qo'shilmaydi.
when: O'tmishda aniq bir vaqtda tugagan ish-harakatlarni ifodalashda.
O'tmishdagi odatiy holatlar yoki ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida gapirganda.
Yesterday, last week, ago kabi signal so'zlari bilan ishlatiladi.

structures.example_en: I went to the cinema yesterday.
She didn't have breakfast this morning.
Did you see that film last week?
structures.example_uz: Siz o'tgan hafta anavi filmni ko'rdingizmi?

structures.label: Wh-
structures.example_en: Where did they go on holiday?

rules.title: Maxsus shakllar
rules.text: Noto'g'ri fe'llar o'tgan zamonda butunlay o'zgaradi, ularga -ed qo'shib bo'lmaydi. Har birini yodlash kerak.

rules.title: Inkor va so'roq gaplar
rules.text: Inkor (-) va so'roq (?) gaplarda 'did' yordamchi fe'li ishlatilgani uchun asosiy fe'l o'zining lug'atdagi (V1) shakliga qaytadi.

examples.en: Did you go? (NOT Did you went?)

mistakes.why: See noto'g'ri fe'l, unga -ed qo'shilmaydi, u saw shakliga o'zgaradi.
So'roq gapda 'did' ishlatilganda fe'l o'zining birinchi (V1) shakliga qaytishi shart.
Inkor gaplarda 'didn't' dan keyin fe'lning o'tgan zamon shakli emas, asliga (have) qaytgan shakli ishlatiladi.

test.q: I ______ to the park yesterday.
test.explain: O'tgan zamon darak gapida 'go' fe'li 'went' shakliga o'zgaradi.

test.q: We ______ breakfast at 8 o'clock this morning.
test.explain: Have fe'li o'tgan zamon darak gapida 'had' bo'ladi.

test.q: She ______ a beautiful dress last week.
test.explain: Buy (sotib olmoq) fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'bought' bo'lib o'zgaradi.

test.q: I ______ my friend in the city centre two days ago.
test.explain: Meet (uchratmoq) fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'met' hisoblanadi.

test.q: They ______ to our house last night.
test.explain: Come fe'li o'tgan zamon darak gapida 'came' shakliga kiradi.

test.q: I ______ (not + see) you at school yesterday.
test.explain: Inkor gapda 'didn't' ishlatiladi va fe'l birinchi shaklda (see) qoladi.

test.q: He ______ a taxi to the airport yesterday.
test.explain: Take fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'took' shaklini oladi.

test.q: We ______ a lot of pizza at the party.
test.explain: Eat (yemoq) fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'ate' bo'ladi.

test.q: The bus ______ the station at 9:00.
test.explain: Leave (ketmoq/tark etmoq) fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'left' shaklida bo'ladi.

test.q: My brother ______ me a new book for my birthday.
test.explain: Give (bermoq) fe'li o'tgan zamon darak gapida 'gave' ga o'zgaradi.

test.q: I ______ the answer to the teacher's question.
test.explain: Know (bilmoq) fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'knew' dir.

test.q: What ______ you eat for lunch yesterday?
test.explain: O'tgan zamon so'roq gaplarida 'did' yordamchi fe'li gap boshida ishlatiladi.

test.q: We ______ (not + go) shopping last weekend.
test.explain: Inkor gapda 'didn't' yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi va asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

test.q: She ______ "Hello" and walked into the room.
test.explain: Say (aytmoq) fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'said' bo'ladi.

test.q: I ______ a new computer last month.
test.explain: Get (olmoq) fe'li o'tgan zamon darak gapida 'got' shakliga o'zgaradi.

test.q: My mother ______ a delicious cake yesterday.
test.explain: Make (tayyorlamoq/qilmoq) fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'made' bo'ladi.

test.q: Did you ______ your car keys?
test.explain: So'roq gapda 'did' bo'lgani uchun fe'lning birinchi shakli (find) ishlatiladi.

test.q: They went to Samarkand three years ______.
test.explain: Vaqt o'tganligini bildirish uchun gap oxirida 'ago' (oldin) so'zi ishlatiladi.

test.q: I saw a great film ______ night.
test.explain: Kecha oqshom demoqchi bo'lsak 'last night' iborasini ishlatamiz.

test.q: Where ______ they meet last week?
test.explain: Maxsus so'roq gaplarda so'roq so'zidan keyin 'did' yordamchi fe'li keladi.

test.q: I ______ a big hamburger for dinner.
test.explain: O'tgan zamon darak gapda 'eat' fe'lining noto'g'ri shakli 'ate' ishlatiladi.

test.q: They ______ to London last year.
test.explain: Go fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'went' ga o'zgaradi.

test.q: Did you ______ the teacher yesterday?
test.explain: So'roq gapda 'did' borligi sababli fe'l o'zgarmasdan 'see' shaklida qoladi.

test.q: We ______ a very good time on holiday.
test.explain: Have fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'had' hisoblanadi.

test.q: She ______ the house at 7:30 this morning.
test.explain: Leave fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'left' shaklida ishlatiladi.

test.q: I ______ my homework yesterday afternoon.
test.explain: Do fe'li bu yerda asosiy fe'l bo'lib, o'tgan zamonda 'did' shaklini oladi.

test.q: He ______ me a beautiful present.
test.explain: Give fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'gave' dir.

test.q: We ______ some new clothes yesterday.
test.explain: Buy fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'bought' shakliga kiradi.

test.q: I ______ the answer to the question.
test.explain: Know fe'li o'tgan zamon darak gapida 'knew' shaklida bo'ladi.

test.q: They ______ to the party together.
test.explain: Come fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'came' hisoblanadi.
